findings.rationale: three unrelated base classes share one module after the rename
findings.explanation: MigrationTestBase, OperationTestBase and OptimizerTestBase all live side by side in the module this PR renames, and the eight importers each pull a different subset. Splitting them would let each test file depend only on what it uses. Nothing about the bodies changed here, so the range is unanchored in the diff.

findings.rationale: cross-package absolute import where every sibling uses a relative one
findings.explanation: This file reaches into the sibling package with an absolute `migrations.base` import while the other seven updated call sites use the relative form. The inconsistency makes the shared helper look like two different modules when grepping.
findings.suggested_fix:
from django.test import modify_settings

from migrations.base import OperationTestBase, OptimizerTestBase  # noqa: E402
